name: live-template
description: 실시간 협업 템플릿 워크스페이스 (디자인 · 코딩 · 문서) — 클라우드플레어 Workers + Durable Objects

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w worker
